qualifier: driving interferon-alpha/beta production
name: RIG-I-like receptor signaling to interferon-alpha/beta production
rationale: All members concern cytosolic RIG-I/MDA5 sensing and its TRAF3/TRAF6-IRF/NF-kB outputs (including viral modulation of it); unlike the confusables, which emphasize dsRNA responses, ISG15, OAS/type III IFN or cytosolic DNA sensing, this theme centres on induction of IFN-alpha/beta and the antiviral IFN signature.

core: Antigen receptor signaling and co-receptor regulation
qualifier: spanning both T and B cells, with inhibitory co-receptors
name: T and B cell antigen receptor signaling with co-receptor tuning
rationale: Members are proximal TCR and BCR signaling events plus CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA/CD22/PECAM1 inhibition; the B cell receptor arm and inhibitory co-receptors distinguish it from confusables that are T-cell activation, differentiation or thymic selection modules.

qualifier: cerebellar and basal ganglia (striatum, substantia nigra)
name: Motor behavior and cerebellar-basal ganglia development
rationale: Members cover locomotion, posture, proprioception and motor learning together with development of cerebellum (Purkinje, granule, Bergmann glia), striatum and substantia nigra; confusables instead carry brainstem/pons development and respiratory control.

core: Regulation of ribosome biogenesis and rRNA transcription
qualifier: MYC target programme and nutrient (methionine) control
name: MYC-linked regulation of ribosome biogenesis and rRNA transcription
rationale: Members concern control of nucleolar rRNA output and ribosome production, including MYC target sets and methionine sensing, which the confusables (RNA polymerase I initiation machinery, B-WICH, NoRC) lack.

qualifier: proteasome assembly, MHC-I antigen processing and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: Proteasome in MHC-I antigen processing and HIV receptor downregulation
rationale: Members are proteasome structure/assembly and proteasome-dependent processes (antigen processing, Nef/Vpu-driven CD4/CD8/CD28/MHC-I loss); confusables are MHC-I peptide loading and cross-presentation routes lacking the proteasome core and viral downregulation.

qualifier: astrocyte specification, migration and reactive gliosis
name: Glial cell development and astrocyte reactivity
rationale: Members regulate glial fate, differentiation, proliferation and survival across oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and Schwann cells; astrocyte migration/activation, reactive gliosis and glial fate specification distinguish it from confusables centred on myelin formation and axon regeneration.

qualifier: palate, nose and limb/digit patterning
name: Embryonic craniofacial, palate and limb morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic morphogenesis of the face, skull, palate and limbs with mesenchymal development; confusables instead involve pharyngeal-derived organs (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid), ear, or ossification and cartilage.

qualifier: by RNA polymerase II and type 3 RNA polymerase III promoters
name: snRNA gene transcription by RNA polymerases II and III
rationale: Members describe transcription of snRNA genes by Pol II and by Pol III from type 3 promoters, including Pol III elongation and termination and U4/U5/U6 snRNP formation; confusables are spliceosome function or tRNA (type 1/2 promoter) Pol III transcription.

core: Post-transcriptional control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: stress granule dynamics and stress-induced translational repression
name: Stress granule regulation of mRNA stability and translation
rationale: Members concern RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability, localization and translation together with stress granule assembly, PKR and arsenite stress; this stress-granule and stabilization emphasis distinguishes it from confusables built on ARE-mediated decay (TTP, KSRP, BRF1) and decapping.

core: Regulation of cardiac contraction and muscle adaptation
qualifier: positive inotropy and stress-induced hypertrophic remodeling
name: Cardiac contractility enhancement and stress-induced striated muscle remodeling
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation and striated muscle adaptation (hypertrophy, sarcomere organization, fiber-type switching); hypertrophic adaptation and positive regulation of contraction separate it from confusables on SR calcium handling or negative chronotropy/inotropy.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and osmotic stress responses
name: Salt and water homeostasis via chloride cotransport and osmosensing
rationale: Members concern sodium, potassium and chloride transport across epithelia (including SLC12/SLC26 channelopathies) and cellular responses to osmotic and salt stress; chloride cotransporter defects, osmosensing and water homeostasis distinguish it from confusables on P-type ATPases, Na+/H+ exchangers, K2P channels or tight junctions.

qualifier: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII-mediated ER export
name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII-mediated ER export
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting into the ER membrane and COPII cargo loading and ER-to-Golgi transport; confusables instead carry ER folding, ERAD, glycosylation, COPI retrograde traffic or connexin transport to the plasma membrane.

core: Nuclear pore complex structure and transport
qualifier: NPC assembly/disassembly and inositol phosphate and HIV Rev transport
name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate/Rev transport
rationale: All members are nucleoporin-centred sets on NPC assembly, disassembly, localization and cargo passage; inositol phosphate and Rev transport plus NPC dynamics distinguish it from confusables on mRNA/ribosome export or nuclear envelope breakdown.

qualifier: with peroxisome biogenesis and cholesterol/isoprenoid biosynthesis
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, fatty acid metabolism and cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisomal protein import, very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acid metabolism, plasmalogen/ether lipid synthesis and the mevalonate-to-cholesterol pathway; the sterol and isoprenoid branch is what the confusables, centred on fatty acid oxidation and transport, lack.

core: T cell adhesion and signaling complex assembly
qualifier: immunological synapse, polarity and chemokine-directed migration
name: T cell immunological synapse formation and chemokine-directed migration
rationale: Members concern lymphocyte adhesion, raft and signal-complex assembly, synapse formation, polarity and chemokine receptor signaling; CORO1A-DEF6 networks, synapse and chemokine members distinguish it from confusables on integrin-mediated leukocyte migration, PECAM1 and Vav1.

qualifier: epidermal migration in wound re-epithelialization
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance and wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and migration and epidermal spreading in wound healing; confusables instead centre on cornification and skin barrier formation or inflammatory IL-20 signaling.

qualifier: fructose and glucuronate-xylulose pentose routes with their inborn errors
name: Fructose catabolism and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose breakdown and the glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pentose route, including fructosuria, fructose intolerance and pentosuria; confusables carry polyols, the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt or galactose metabolism instead.

qualifier: taste receptor and olfactory/pheromone receptor detection
name: Taste and olfactory chemosensory perception
rationale: All members concern detection and perception of tastants, odorants and pheromones by taste and olfactory receptors; confusables carry TRP/acid-sensing channels or olfactory nerve and nose development instead.

qualifier: central nervous system
name: Oligodendrocyte development and central nervous system myelination
rationale: Members concern CNS myelin formation and maintenance, regulation of myelination and oligodendrocyte/glial differentiation and proliferation; the CNS oligodendrocyte focus separates it from confusables with Schwann cell/PNS myelination, astrocyte migration or axon growth signaling.

qualifier: Ca2+ branch and retinal/blood-brain vascular barrier development
name: Non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling and retinal-vascular barrier development
rationale: Members are WNT5A/Frizzled/ROR2 Ca2+ signaling and its regulation together with blood-brain and blood-retinal barrier, retinal vessel and RPE development; confusables carry Wnt ligand secretion or lens and anterior eye development instead.

qualifier: ubiquitin chain linkage types, deubiquitinases and proteasome assembly
name: Ubiquitin chain assembly, deubiquitination and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Most members concern ubiquitin activation and linkage-specific chain synthesis, DUB families, proteasome assembly and regulation of proteasomal catabolism; confusables instead centre on autophagy and ERAD quality control or neddylation and the COP9 signalosome.

qualifier: nucleotide sugar transporters and sialic acid metabolism
name: Nucleotide sugar transport and sialic acid metabolism for glycosylation
rationale: Members are SLC35-family nucleotide sugar transport and its congenital disorders, related Golgi/ER substrate transporters and sialic acid and amino sugar metabolism; confusables instead carry N-glycan processing, GPI anchoring, UDP-GlcNAc synthesis or GDP-fucose synthesis.

qualifier: vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
name: Isoprenoid quinone synthesis and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members link mevalonate/prenyl diphosphate synthesis to ubiquinone and vitamin K quinones and to vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation; gamma-carboxylation separates it from cholesterol confusables, and the isoprenoid branch from vitamin E and D confusables.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and neutrophil bacterial killing
name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and neutrophil bacterial killing
rationale: Members regulate superoxide/H2O2 generation by the phagocyte NADPH oxidase and its use in neutrophil degranulation and pathogen killing; confusables instead carry macrophage anti-inflammatory/toxin uptake or hyperoxia and neutrophil apoptosis.

core: Non-coding RNA modification and RNP biogenesis
qualifier: RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP assembly and trafficking
name: RNA methylation and small nuclear/nucleolar RNP biogenesis
rationale: Members concern methylation of rRNA, tRNA, snRNA caps and guanine-N7 together with snRNP/box C/D snoRNP assembly and Cajal body trafficking; confusables instead carry pseudouridylation, diphthamide or ribosome assembly.
